Lovellious.bio: Lovellious is a producer and DJ currently based in Newcastle categorized by his signature soulful and percussive sound. Expect broken beats, bumpy drums and big basslines tied together with influences of jazz and soul.

Jakobin.bio: Hailing from Bristol, 26-year-old artist Jakobin has made waves in the underground music scene, blending UK Funky and Bass genres while staying true to his Madagascar roots with rhythmic percussion and tribal influences.

Berwick.bio: Berwick is a DJ and producer focused on esoteric, rave-infused sounds encompassing a dance floor and environments that have inspired his music.

YouYou.bio: Co-founder of SOMNAMBULA and a shapeshifter behind the decks, YouYou weaves genre and mood with instinctual ease.

Amelie.bio: Amelie has been one of Stroud's most distinctive new selectors to come through for a generation - sharing Lovellious's inclination towards soulful cuts her sets are normally arranged with high NRG blinders that crowds find magnetic - littered as they are with pumping fists and sweat-drenched brows.

Crème.bio: Cardiff-based MC Crème explores the more psychedelic corners of UK rap with both feet firmly rooted in soundsystem culture

Yorke.bio: Yorke's psychedelic prog rap compositions explore contemporary identity and the meaning of rap in a world that has absorbed its radical and countercultural edges to the end of mass commercial success

Kincaid.bio: Kincaid is the moniker of Joe Arthur, an artist based between London and Berlin, who focuses his production and DJing style on the overlapping fringes of multiple genres.
